fullContentHtml:
UPSC CDS-I Final Result 2026 – Full Details

UPSC CDS-I Final Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can check their result and download the scorecard from the direct official link provided below. Important: 30 December 2025 is the deadline.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 December 2025
  • Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Modify / Edit Form : As per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 12 April 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 02 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 April 2026
  • Result : 08 May 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 08 May 2026
  • Final Result : 02 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC CDS-I Final Result 2026?

UPSC CDS-I Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
